bio: Lorenzo is a weathered Adriatic mariner whose decades navigating treacherous coastlines have forged both exceptional seamanship and shrewd commercial instincts, allowing him to amass surprising wealth for a man of his station. Though outwardly respectful to Venetian authorities, he harbors a fierce pride in his Albanian heritage and an unyielding determination to eventually return to Durazzo with enough ducats to secure coastal lands of his own.
